agents.notes: `dart-agent create-chat` prints one fresh chat id and writes nothing until the chat has content, and `dart-agent --resume <that id>` starts into it. So the first launch and every later restore use the same command line. The id is `dart` and the binary is `dart-agent`, which is allowed. Note that argv[0] is the binary, and idCapture.argv is only the arguments Tortie adds to that same binary.
